result.instructions: Tools for Fleetio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our vehicles have open work orders right now, and which shop has each one?"; "List service reminders marked due soon for our delivery vans."; "How much did we spend on fuel last month across all vehicles?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fleetio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fleetio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fleetio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fleetio_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. fleetio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fleetio_create_issue
tools.title: Create issue
tools.description: WRITE: create a new issue (a reported defect) on a vehicle or equipment. Fleetio may notify the people who watch or are assigned to it. Needs the asset id (fleetio_list_vehicles) and a summary; the report time defaults to now. Does not close, resolve or delete anything. POST /issues.

asset_id.description: Id of the vehicle or equipment the issue is about.

reported_at.description: When the issue was reported (ISO 8601, default now).

due_date.description: When it should be resolved by (ISO 8601).

tools.name: fleetio_create_meter_entry
tools.title: Add meter entry
tools.description: WRITE: record an odometer / engine-hour meter reading for a vehicle (primary meter, or the secondary meter with secondary=true). Fleetio rejects a value that breaks the sequence (a reading must not be lower than an earlier one by date); it cannot be deleted from here. The date defaults to now. A new reading can make service reminders due or overdue, and Fleetio may notify their watchers. POST /meter_entries.

value.description: Meter value in the vehicle's meter unit (miles, km or hours).

date.description: When the reading was taken (ISO 8601, default now).

secondary.description: true = the vehicle's secondary meter (default: primary).

tools.name: fleetio_add_comment
tools.title: Add comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to an issue, work order, service entry, service reminder, vehicle or part. Fleetio notifies the watchers of that record (and anyone @mentioned in the text). Comments added here cannot be edited or deleted by this server. POST /comments.

commentable_type.description: Type of the record to comment on.

commentable_id.description: Id of the record (not its number).
